name: TROP
recent: Tropicana 近期持续进行股份回购，同时大股东兼集团执行副主席 Tan Sri Dato' Tan Chee Sing 及 Tan Sri Dr Lim Wee Chai 申报股权变动，主席增持 1600 万股。公司 2026 财年第二季转亏，但营收同比大幅增长。
notable: 主席 Tan Sri Tan Chee Sing 增持 1600 万股，并多次申报股权变动。
公司于 10 月底至 11 月中多次进行股份回购。
2026 财年第二季营收同比大增，但净利转亏。
risks: 2026 财年第二季净利转亏，净亏损 590.5 万令吉。
董事在闭窗期前申报有意交易公司证券。
earnings: 2026 财年第二季营收 8.5077 亿令吉，环比增长 171.2%，同比增长 157.7%；净亏损 590.5 万令吉，净利率 -0.7%，较上季 -4.6% 收窄，但净利同比下滑 158.8%。

recent_en: Tropicana has been actively buying back shares, while major shareholder and Group Executive Vice Chairman Tan Sri Dato' Tan Chee Sing and Tan Sri Dr Lim Wee Chai have reported changes in their shareholdings, with the Chairman raising his stake by 16 million shares. The company returned to a loss in 2Q FY2026 despite a sharp year-on-year revenue jump.
notable_en: Chairman Tan Sri Tan Chee Sing raised his stake by 16 million shares and filed multiple shareholding change notices.
The company conducted multiple share buybacks from late October to mid-November.
2Q FY2026 revenue rose sharply year-on-year, but the company swung to a net loss.
risks_en: The company swung to a net loss of MYR5.905 million in 2Q FY2026.
A director declared intention to deal in the company's securities ahead of the closed period.
earnings_en: 2Q FY2026 revenue was MYR850.77 million, up 171.2% qoq and 157.7% yoy; net loss was MYR5.905 million with a net margin of -0.7%, narrower than -4.6% in the prior quarter, while net income fell 158.8% yoy.
